scope: Shorter wall-clock observation replaces150steps; fresh workers eachcase from CPU-only torch-preloaded forkserver. Different observation length and padding from previous cohorts; no pooled accuracy or improvement claim. Fixed host delays are proxies, not DVFS or paper percentage labels.
cohort_policy: This 36-row matrix stands alone; do not pool the earlier 22-run matrix or three-run dual-view pilot.

measurement_windows.last_10: rank0 steps max(0, actual_steps-10) through actual_steps-1
measurement_windows.timing_interpretation: Iteration-time and inverse-iteration-time throughput proxy only; time_ms ends before Gloo stop broadcast and excludes the next batch and initialization barrier, so it is not end-to-end cost.

metrics.online_outputs: Union of identified_ranks from every SLOW_RANK_IDENTIFIED and no_localization terminal event, including alarms from invalid profiles.
metrics.invalid_run_credit: Invalid runs receive no TP or exact-correct credit. Observed FP remains counted across invalid and unrun rows.
metrics.conditional_metrics: Precision/recall use valid runs only; valid controls contribute FP; recall denominator is valid planned positives.
metrics.fixed_denominators: Exact-correct denominator is all 28 planned positives; clean-control denominator is all 8 planned controls.
metrics.fault_delays: Recorded planned values 14/100/200 ms are retained as proxies and are not calibrated or converted to paper percentages.
